title: Stop at the double bond
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Lindlar catalyst reduces an alkyne to an alkene without normally continuing to the alkane. Propyne therefore gives propene under these conditions.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propyne under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propyne is treated with H₂ and Lindlar catalyst. Which major organic product forms after workup? Lindlar catalyst reduces an alkyne to an alkene without normally continuing to the alkane. Propyne therefore gives propene under these conditions.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
